Lake to Lake Friday Ride

Oklahoma City, OK · North May Avenue · Road

No-drop

Lake to Lake Friday Ride is a road group ride in Oklahoma City, OK. It rolls every Friday at 6:30 pm from Phat Tire Bike Shop, Oklahoma City (May Avenue). About 30 miles, ~17.5 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 5 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Lake to Lake Friday Ride group ride

A Friday evening loop from the May Avenue shop out to Lake Hefner and Lake Overholser and back, about 30 miles at around 17.5 mph. Billed as no-drop. Weather dependent.
